hypothesis: A learned per-case gate can select query-derived room partitioning only when it preserves dense topology while retaining instance/count/GED gains.

train_labels.utility: Accept query routing only when room IoU and instance F1 are non-regressing on the training case and the structural proxy does not fall.
train_labels.tie_rule: Prefer the dense fallback on utility ties.

gates.calibration: Selected cases improve Room IoU and instance F1 vs dense; rejected cases are bitwise dense.
gates.holdout: Offset128 has no plan-plausibility or wall-continuity regression and retains positive count direction.
gates.full_validation: Room IoU >= dense, instance F1 > dense, count MAE lower, GED lower, plan plausibility >= 0.95, wall continuity >= 0.98.
gates.statistics: Case-level paired bootstrap, Wilcoxon, and rank-biserial effect sizes.

safety_fallback.trigger: Target-free explicit-plan validity or wall-continuity failure after query routing.
safety_fallback.fallback_prediction: The frozen dense room prediction for that case.

outcome.reason: No reliable benefit over the safety-only ablation; Room and graph differences have confidence intervals crossing zero while F1, Node, and Edge are slightly lower.
outcome.retained_mechanism: global class-region query routing plus target-free explicit-plan safety fallback
